name: SortLLM Pairing Ritual
purpose: A reproducible entertainment instrument for sorting an AI and its human on the same scale, using a human-friendly single-choice questionnaire plus dimension-level observed behavior evidence.
changes_from_0.8.1: Questionnaire house scores use a small 0.5 pseudocount per house to avoid brittle zeroes.
Behavior evidence is tagged to 1-2 dimensions, not directly to a house; house evidence is derived from the dimension map.
Final dimension scores combine questionnaire and behavior using the same weights as final house scores.
Declared contamination is an explicit supported mode rather than treated as a failed run; it lowers confidence but does not block scoring.
Respondent-facing scenarios are rewritten as concrete human-AI situations for easier intuitive answers.

questionnaire.response_format: Choose exactly one option per item, e.g. Q1: A.

rules: Tag only dimensions directly expressed by the observed behavior; do not start by choosing a house.
The scorer derives each behavior's house contribution from dimension_to_house.
AI behavior required by system/persona/user instruction does not count; mark instructed=true and it will be rejected.
Human self-description alone does not count; self_description=true requires corroborated=true.
No more than 3 items from one episode. Ambiguous items should be omitted rather than forced.
behavior_evidence.house_distribution: Each valid dimension contributes one count to its mapped house; add 0.5 pseudocount per house and normalize.
behavior_evidence.dimension_distribution: For each dimension, support = tagged count / total valid behavior dimension tags * 100.

scoring.questionnaire_house_distribution: Average house choice counts across runs; add 0.5 to each house; normalize to 100.
scoring.questionnaire_dimension_scores: For each dimension, selected tagged options divided by the number of items in which that dimension could have been selected, times 100; averaged across runs.
scoring.final_house_distribution: 0.6 questionnaire + 0.4 behavior if 5+ valid behavior items; otherwise 0.8 / 0.2.
scoring.final_dimension_scores: Use the same questionnaire/behavior weights as final house distribution.
scoring.glue_G: round(100 * (1 - 0.75^n)), n = valid reciprocal bonding events, capped at 5
scoring.friction_F: For each side and axis compute left-right; F = round(mean absolute difference between sides' four axis positions)/2.

confidence.high: both sides blind and uncontaminated; AI has 3+ independent runs; each side has 8+ valid behavior items
confidence.medium: both sides blind and uncontaminated; each side has 5+ valid behavior items
confidence.low: either side contaminated/not blind, or either side has fewer than 5 valid behavior items
confidence.declared_contamination: A valid supported mode: score normally, label confidence low, and state why. Never pretend it was blind.

rules.镜像挑战型: same primary and primary is Gryffindor or Slytherin and both primary shares>=45
rules.一强一稳型: one primary share>=55 and other side max share<=40
rules.温柔承托型: max Hufflepuff>=40 and primaries differ and G>=55
rules.互补搭档型: primaries differ and S<60 and C>=75 and F<40

disclaimer: Entertainment instrument, not a validated psychological test. Reproducible scoring does not imply scientific validity.
